strategy.name: BTC_Breakout_5m_LowSpread
strategy.rationale: BTC 0.02% spread enables breakout scalping 24/7. 15-bar breakout with RSI trend filter and momentum avoids false breaks; wider hold captures real moves past noise.

history.analysis: PF 0.67, WR 27.5%: mean-reversion fades keep stopping out. Stops eat $122, trails only $47. Spread $24.78 on 40 trades signals overtrading. Time exits profitable net—holds too short on winners, stops too tight on losers.
mistakes: Stop exits dominate losses (-$122): stop placement at 0.22% too tight for XAU 5m noise, triggering before mean-reversion completes
WR 27.5% is far below the ~45%+ needed for 2:1 R:R to be profitable—strategy needs either higher WR or better R:R, not both mediocre
ETH avoided (correct given 0.16% cost) but BTC scalps on 5m showed repeated time-exits near breakeven, indicating no real edge there either
Cooldown 20min too short—back-to-back stops visible in journal (3 consecutive XAU stops), compounding losses in trending moves
changes: Abandon pure mean-reversion fades—replace with trend-confirmation breakout or momentum entries that align with short-term trend
Widen stop to 0.35%+ on XAU to survive noise; raise TP to 0.70%+ for minimum 2:1 after spread; accept fewer but cleaner trades
Extend cooldown to 45min and maxHoldMinutes to 90 to let winners breathe; time-exit pnl was positive suggesting more patience rewarded

strategy.name: BTC_Breakout_5m_LowSpread
strategy.rationale: BTC 0.02% spread enables breakout scalping 24/7. 15-bar breakout with RSI trend filter and momentum avoids false breaks; wider hold captures real moves past noise.

history.analysis: WR 28% with PF 0.69 is deeply unprofitable. Stops dominate losses (-$119). Trail exits are only profitable exit type. Spread consumed $24 on tiny winners. 1m lag on cron makes entries stale; signals fire into exhausted moves.
mistakes: Stop exits catastrophic (-$118.73 total): stop distance 0.15% too tight for 1m XAU noise, repeatedly stopped before move develops
Win rate 28% far too low for 1:1.4 R:R - need either higher WR or better R:R to overcome spread drag
Trailing stop at 0.12% locks in near-zero wins (e.g. -0.04, +0.94) while spread eats the gain
1m candle + cron lag = entering on stale breakouts already partially played out, especially XAU London open spikes
changes: Widen stop to 0.25-0.3% to survive 1m noise and reduce stop-exit dominance
Raise TP to 0.6-0.8% so reward clearly exceeds spread multiple times over
Move to 5m candles to reduce cron-lag staleness and filter microstructure noise
Drop ETH entirely; focus XAU (cheapest) and BTC (second cheapest)
Replace SMA cross entry with momentum + bollinger squeeze to catch real breakouts not lagged crosses

strategy.name: XAU_RSI_Mean_Reversion_5m
strategy.rationale: Opposite philosophy to trend: fade extreme RSI within active session using Bollinger band touch. Shorter hold, lower TP but very defined risk. Catches frequent intraday overextensions in XAU cheaply.

history.analysis: PF 0.75, WR 29.7%: system loses. Trail exits profitable but stops dominate losses. Spread $23.49 on $-32.94 net means spread alone nearly explains losses. BTC time-exits mostly losers; XAU stop exits large negative outliers.
mistakes: Win rate 29.7% requires R:R >2.4 to break even; current TP/SL ~2.2 is insufficient - math never works
BTC spread 0.02% still too costly for these tiny 0.25% stop scalps - net edge consumed by spread on most trades
SMA9/21 cross on 5m is a lagging entry - price has already moved, entry chases and stops trigger before target
maxHoldMinutes 60-65 exits profitable XAU runners early (4150->4173 was held to time, not trailed properly) and also exits losing BTC at time with big losses
changes: Raise R:R to minimum 3:1 (TP/SL ratio) so 30% WR is mathematically profitable
Tighten SL to 0.18% but push TP to 0.55%+ giving true 3:1 after spread
Add breakout confirmation so entry is on momentum already established, reducing false entries
Extend maxHoldMinutes to 120 to let winners run via trail rather than time-killing them
Raise cooldown to 60min to avoid regime-repeat losses

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_London_1m
strategy.rationale: 1m candles tighten entry lag vs cron. London open only for strongest directional flow. SMA cross plus breakout plus ATR spike catches genuine intraday trend ignition early.

history.analysis: WR 24% with PF 0.71: too many small losers eating spread. Stops hit 71% of net loss. Time exits profitable but tiny. ETH avoided (wise). Breakout signals firing in chop—entries don't stay valid long enough.
mistakes: Breakout on 5m fires in ranging markets: 6 of last 7 BTC trades lost small, all time-exits—classic chop signal failure paying spread repeatedly
Stop at 0.4% vs TP at 0.9% gives ~2.25R but WR needs 31%+ to break even; actual WR 24% is well below that threshold
20-bar breakout on 5m is only 100 minutes of history—too short, generates false breakouts in sideways BTC action
Trailing stop 0.35% too tight for BTC 5m ATR, getting stopped out of winning trades early (trail PnL only $42 on 3 trades)
changes: Drop ETH permanently—8x spread cost makes scalping mathematically hostile at this account size
Raise breakout period to filter noise, or replace breakout with trend-following SMA cross to reduce false signals
Widen stop, tighten TP ratio to ~1.5R minimum but require higher WR setup, OR keep 2R but add stricter entry filters to raise WR above 35%
Add session filter to concentrate BTC trades in high-liquidity UTC 08-22 window
Reduce riskPerTradePct to 0.4% to slow drawdown while system is unproven

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_Session
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). SMA cross trend filter on active London/NY session only avoids weekend gaps and low-volume chop. Momentum confirmation raises WR.

history.analysis: 27% WR, PF 0.78, net -$22.81. Stops dominate (-$94). Mean reversion fires but moves reverse before TP. Zero trades last 25h suggests v5 conditions too tight. BTC RSI 78 overbought, XAU RSI 27 oversold - actionable now.
mistakes: Stop losses too tight (0.35%) relative to ATR on 5m XAU - stopped out on noise before mean reversion plays out
Mean reversion counter-trend on BTC (trending asset) consistently loses - 6 BTC longs into pullbacks all stopped
takeProfitPct 0.9% rarely hit on scalp timeframes; trailing stop 0.4% gives back most of winner before exit
Bollinger + RSI <42/>58 combo on v5 too restrictive - zero fires in 25h despite RSI 27 on XAU right now
changes: Drop BTC mean reversion - only trade BTC with-trend via breakout/SMA cross
XAU mean reversion: widen stop to 0.55% to survive noise, tighten TP to 0.6% for higher hit rate
Loosen RSI thresholds to <35/>65 so conditions actually fire at extremes like current XAU RSI 27
Add ETH momentum trend following - cheap enough with clean 5m SMA cross signals
Reduce cooldown from 25m to 15m to capture more of limited valid setups per session

strategy.name: BTC_Breakout_Trend
strategy.rationale: BTC trends well. Breakout of 20-bar high/low with RSI momentum confirmation trades WITH trend not against it. Avoids counter-trend losses that dominated BTC history. Spread justified by move size.

history.analysis: 27% WR, PF 0.78, net -$22.81. Stops dominate (-$94). RSI<33 on XAU almost never fires in current range. Zero trades in 24h = rules too strict. Must loosen entry thresholds and add volume/breakout logic.
mistakes: RSI<33 long trigger on XAU is too extreme - current RSI 46.7 and has rarely dipped that low, causing zero signals for 24h+
27% win rate means entries are wrong directionally more than 2/3 of time - counter-trend pullback logic failing in trending markets
Stop losses hit 94% of loss value while trails captured only $42 profit - stops too tight relative to 5m noise on XAU
Momentum filter op direction on short is wrong (should be < negative value, not < 0.15 which is almost always true)
changes: Drop RSI threshold from <33 to <42 for longs, >58 for shorts - realistic given current RSI 43-47 range across all markets
Add breakout confirmation to avoid pure counter-trend fades - require price breaking recent low/high to confirm momentum
Add session filter for XAU: restrict to 07:00-20:00 UTC (London+NY overlap) where liquidity is highest
Remove ETH entirely - 0.16% round-trip spread is 14x XAU, mathematically requires much larger moves to profit on scalp
Shift from pure pullback to trend-following breakout on 5m - breakout strategies have better win rates in momentum markets

strategy.name: XAU_RSI_Mean_Reversion_Loose
strategy.rationale: Looser RSI thresholds (<42/>58) with Bollinger band touch confirmation. Session-filtered. Keeps counter-trend logic but requires band extreme to avoid false entries.

history.analysis: PF 0.78, WR 27% with avgW>avgL but too few winners. Stops dominate losses (-$94). Time exits slightly profitable. Spread cost ($17) is ~75% of gross losses. Entries firing into chop or against momentum.
mistakes: Win rate 27% is far too low for the R:R ratio used - need either wider TP or higher-quality entries to reach breakeven WR ~30%
Stops account for -$94 of losses while trails only made +$42 - stop placement at 0.3% is too tight for 5m BTC/XAU noise, triggering on normal wick retracements
Time exits occasionally profitable (+$29) suggesting some trades are correct direction but TP too close or trailing stop too tight to capture the move
Multiple consecutive BTC longs stopped out near same price level (64745, 64775, 64561) - no cooldown respected or market was in clear range/chop, ATR filter too low at 0.08%
changes: Tighten RSI to 32/68 to ensure deeper genuine pullbacks only
Widen stopLossPct to 0.45% to survive normal noise, adjust TP to 1.05% for better R:R
Add sma_cross confirmation to ensure trend is active not just price above static SMA
Increase ATR filter to 0.12% minimum to avoid dead chop periods
Reduce riskPerTradePct to 0.5% to protect capital given current drawdown

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_Pullback_Deep
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). Deep RSI pullbacks in SMA-cross confirmed trends only. Wider stops survive noise. High ATR filter kills chop. Best spread efficiency of all markets.

history.analysis: 27.8% WR with PF 0.68 is deeply unprofitable. Stops account for -$79 loss; trails only +$42. Breakout entries are chasing moves that reverse immediately. XAU longs consistently stop out. Spread at $14.67 on 18 trades is a major drag.
mistakes: Breakout entries on closed candles arrive late - buying the top of the move, not the start. By the time cron fires, breakout is already extended and reversal risk is high.
0.3% stop vs 0.75% TP gives ~2.5R but WR of 28% means expectancy is negative. Need either higher WR setups or tighter entries that improve actual R:R realized.
XAU longs dominate the trade log with 7 of 8 losing. Likely entering during weak pullback continuation attempts in a choppy range rather than genuine trending moments.
Trailing stop of 0.2% on 5m BTC is too tight - profitable BTC trail (63627 entry) exited at breakeven with -$0.02 PnL despite the setup triggering. Trails are being clipped by normal noise.
changes: Switch from breakout-chase to mean-reversion pullback entries: enter after RSI oversold/overbought extremes WITH trend context, so entry is at value not at extension.
Drop ETH entirely - 0.16% round-trip is 8x BTC, makes scalping near-impossible. Focus BTC and XAU only.
Widen trailing stop to 0.35-0.4% to let winners breathe past microstructure noise on 5m candles.
Raise ATR filter threshold to ensure minimum volatility, AND add RSI extreme condition to require both volatility AND overextension before entry.
Increase breakout lookback to 40 bars (200 min) for structural significance on any remaining breakout logic.

strategy.name: RSI_Pullback_Trend_BTC_XAU
strategy.rationale: Buy RSI dips in uptrends, sell RSI pops in downtrends. Entries at value not extension. SMA50 defines trend; RSI30/70 defines pullback. Avoids chasing breakouts that reverse on cron lag.

history.analysis: 7/8 trades lost. Only 1 winner via time-exit. Mean-reversion fighting trend in falling market. XAU longs repeatedly stopped in downtrend. BTC signals contradictory. Spread costs minor vs directional losses.
mistakes: Trading mean-reversion (long oversold) in a persistent downtrend - XAU fell consistently, all 5 XAU longs lost
No trend filter: entering longs when price is below SMA confirms downtrend, not bounce setup
TP 0.9% vs SL 0.45% gives 2:1 but mean-reversion on 5m rarely reaches 0.9% before reversing again - only 1 time-exit won
maxHoldMinutes 60 too short for TP to be reached, yet long enough to accumulate losses - most exits were stop or timeout losers
changes: Add trend filter (price_vs_sma) to only trade in direction of trend - no counter-trend longs in downtrend
Switch to breakout/momentum strategy instead of mean-reversion to align with prevailing momentum
Tighten TP to 0.45% and SL to 0.25% for higher win-rate scalps, or use asymmetric 3:1 with confirmed momentum
Add session filter on XAU to avoid low-liquidity periods and weekend gap risk
Reduce riskPerTradePct to 0.8% given losing streak and capital preservation rules

strategy.name: TrendBreakout_BTC_XAU
strategy.rationale: Breakout above N-bar high with trend confirmation and momentum. Rides established moves rather than fading them. XAU session-filtered to avoid weekend gaps and illiquid hours.

history.analysis: Extreme RSI oversold + Bollinger lower-band touch signals mean-reversion bounce. BTC and XAU have low spread costs. Avoids chop via ATR filter. Aligns with current deeply oversold snapshot.
